EDITORIAL INK
Warm paper, ink black, one oxblood accent. The margin is a first-class column: citations, diagnostics and provenance live there, exactly where marginalia belong.

Motion: ink settles — a wipe from the left, then a rise out of blur. Nothing bounces.
The three app surfaces, all wired to the real Concept Graph — not mock JSON. Copy and numbers here follow the fixture chapter (OpenStax Astronomy 2e).
